Assignment: Module 8 (Linguistic Markup)

Overview: In this assignment, you will parse a 20-word excerpt of your primary manuscript witness across three distinct tiers: (1) manual grammatical and lexical parse using an authoritative dictionary; (2) deterministic NLP tagging with TreeTagger or SpaCy; and (3) prompt-engineered AI parsing in VS Code. You will compare accuracy, document edge cases and disambiguation failures, and build a TEI linguistic XML fragment using <w> elements with lemma= and pos= attributes.

Deadline: due Friday, October 30, by 11:00 PM.
